$comment: Task plan for AI coding agents. Read AGENTS.md section 7 for how to use this file. Owner: Anderson Mwangi.

project.name: Akili Moto
project.summary: Daily shared trivia challenge with ten multiple-choice questions, seven in English and three in Swahili, server-scored points, and a daily leaderboard.

rules.pickNext: First task with status todo whose dependsOn tasks are all done.
neverDo: weaken auth or tests to pass a task
invent or generate Swahili words for the answer list or dictionary
send the daily answer to the client before the game is finished

decisions.question: Player identity
decisions.default: Anonymous player id in a signed HttpOnly cookie, optional public handle, no email or password in v1

decisions.question: Durable Objects needed?
decisions.default: No. Attempt limits and concurrency are enforced by database unique constraints

decisions.question: Package layout
decisions.default: Single package with src/worker, src/client, src/shared

decisions.question: Letter model for Swahili
decisions.default: Word length 5, letters a to z only, digraphs (ch, sh, ny, ng and so on) treated as separate letters, ng' stored as ng

decisions.question: Word list source and licensing
decisions.default: Owner supplies answers list and a larger dictionary. Source and licence recorded in docs/WORDLISTS.md. Agent never invents words
alternatives: Licensed open dictionary filtered by the owner

decisions.question: Day boundary
decisions.default: Midnight Africa/Nairobi (UTC+3, no DST), decided by the server

decisions.question: Sheng mode
decisions.default: Out of scope for v1, separate list and mode later

decisions.question: Daily quiz format
decisions.default: Ten four-option questions per Nairobi day, seven English and three Swahili, shared in the same order

decisions.question: Scoring
decisions.default: 100 points for a correct answer and a server-measured speed bonus up to 20 points during the first 20 seconds

decisions.question: Leaderboard ties
decisions.default: Equal point totals share rank; only completed challenges are ranked

decisions.question: Question content review
decisions.default: Sourced starter bank is a draft; owner and fluent Swahili reviewer approve before production

phases.name: Daily quiz MVP
phases.goal: Deliver a fair, fast daily trivia challenge with server-owned scoring and a shared leaderboard.

tasks.title: Replace Wordle MVP with the daily trivia challenge
tasks.description: Implement the approved ten-question shared daily challenge with a 7 English / 3 Swahili mix, server-side scoring, anonymous answer persistence, and a completed-player leaderboard. Keep the sourced starter bank draft-only pending owner and fluent reviewer approval. Preserve existing Wordle migrations as inactive legacy schema.
acceptance: All players receive the same ten question IDs in the same order for a Nairobi day, with seven English and three Swahili questions.
The client cannot submit score, answer keys, or future question IDs; the server validates sequence and calculates points.
One player cannot score twice for a question through retries or concurrent requests.
The answer, explanation, and source appear only after that question is answered.
Only completed sessions appear in the daily leaderboard; equal scores share rank and responses omit player IDs.
The React app handles loading, error, answer feedback, progress, completion, and leaderboard states on mobile layouts.
The sourced question bank is documented as a draft requiring human review before production.
tasks.notes: Implemented the daily trivia MVP on task/quiz-daily-challenge. Local D1 migration applied. Verification: typecheck passed; lint passed with five non-blocking style warnings; all 27 tests passed; production build and client leak check passed; Cloudflare deploy dry run passed. Question bank remains a sourced draft pending owner and fluent Swahili review. No remote migration or deployment was run.
